sections.heading: What the e-Business visa covers
sections.text:
The e-Business visa is for short business trips to India, such as attending meetings, trade fairs and conferences, selling or buying products, setting up business ventures, and technical visits. It is valid for 1 year with multiple entries.

It does not allow you to take up employment in India. If you are going to work for an Indian company, you need an Employment visa.

sections.heading: What you will need
sections.text:
As well as your passport scan and photo, you usually need:
- Your business card, or an email signature with your details
- An invitation letter from the Indian company, with their address and contact details
- Details of your own employer or business

Make sure the company details on the invitation match what you enter in the form.

sections.heading: Business visa help for UK companies
sections.text: We handle Indian business visas for individuals and for companies that send staff to India regularly, including urgent applications. We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. Most travel visa applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.

faqs.q: How long does an India e-Business visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but apply at least 4 days before you travel. Leave more time if your trip is close to a public holiday.

faqs.q: Can I work in India on an e-Business visa?
faqs.a: No. Paid employment in India requires an Employment visa.

faqs.q: How long is an India e-Business visa valid?
faqs.a: It is valid for 1 year from the date it is granted, with multiple entries.
